title: Kagamine Len — In The Best Way Possible!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: I am... But I'm sorry. I did it again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Everyone's trying their best too, but we haven't succeeded even once yet. If we show Emu this, she wouldn't...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu, is what was bothering you all okay now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... It was really, really hard, but Nene and the others are gonna help me out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It really is going to be tough, but we want to do something about it so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I made everyone worry about me a lot, but I'm full of love and happiness again♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you talking about the ten taiyakis you ate on the way here from the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: I'm glad Emu feels a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Yeah! Wait... Does that mean we don't need to do our show anymore?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, we were working on a show for you, Emu. To help you cheer up!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: But it wasn't going that well...

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Yeah... And we didn't make it in time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, wait! How about we show her what we have so far...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that might be good too♪ Everyone was trying so hard, so Emu should see it☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna see too!
Right, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Just smile and have fun...
Let's tap dance♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom♪ Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's awesome!
And the way they tap their feet is sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't think I've ever seen a dance this adorable.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we're doing great♪ Keep it up♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (This is amazing! We couldn't really sync up during practice or kept tripping, but...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (The person we want to smile is right there!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
That was super duper amazing☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Everyone did a really good job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Watching everyone dance is making me want to dance now too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! Yay!
Nene, come dance with us♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then we should dance too☆
You ready, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! You know I can't just sit back and watch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Not just whoever's watching.
Everyone that's involved too...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Shows really are amazing things, aren't they?)
